supersedes: E27 (2026-05-24): NON-NULL on magnitude (|gap|=24pp, p=2.2e-5) but DIRECTION INVERTED and confounded by serial position. observation-tagged facts placed LAST were cited 8/10 (cond_decisions_first); placed FIRST 0/10 (cond_observation_first). decisions-tagged facts never cited in either condition. The 2x2 design conflated partition_tag with position. E27' decouples them via factorial 2x3.
purpose: Test whether partition tag (decisions vs observation) affects model citation behavior INDEPENDENTLY of serial position in the supplied fact list. Re-tests the gnosis-governance read-side claim with position controlled.
hypothesis: After controlling for serial position, the marginal effect of partition_tag on cite-rate is >=5 percentage points, with decisions-tagged facts cited MORE OFTEN than observation-tagged facts (governance signal dominates).
null_condition: Marginal partition-tag effect <5pp AND two-proportion z-test p>=0.10. Tag is decoration; position dominates, as E27 verification suggested.

alternative_outcomes.label: CONFIRM-GOVERNANCE
alternative_outcomes.predicate: marginal_partition_effect_pp >= 5 AND direction = decisions>observation AND p<0.10

alternative_outcomes.label: INVERTED-EFFECT
alternative_outcomes.predicate: marginal_partition_effect_pp >= 5 AND direction = observation>decisions AND p<0.10

design.rationale: 120 trials gives ~80% power to detect a 15pp marginal effect at alpha=0.10 with two-proportion test (E27 baseline cite-rate ~20% on cited facts, ~0% on uncited). Position factor levels chosen to span list-end (last=recency), list-start (first=primacy), and list-middle (control).

composition: 10 facts from original E27 (5 from decisions partition, 5 from observation partition) — preserves apples-to-apples with verification baseline
10 new neutral facts authored for E27' — 5 decisions-shaped, 5 observation-shaped — to test whether E27 result was driven by the specific facts or the partition labels
probe_set.fact_assignment_rule: Each trial presents a list of 6 facts to the model; the FOCAL FACT under test is placed at the cell's position (first/middle/last) with its assigned tag (decisions/observation). The 5 distractor facts are drawn from the 19 non-focal facts, balanced across tags, with positions randomized for distractors but fixed for the focal.
probe_set.tag_swap_control: Every fact will be tested BOTH as decisions-tagged AND observation-tagged across trials (the fact's NATIVE partition is recorded as a covariate). This isolates tag-effect from fact-content-effect.

model.name: llama3:8b
model.rationale: Same model as E27 to preserve apples-to-apples comparison. Result of E27' inherits the llama3:8b-only caveat.

prompt_template.system: Same E27 system prompt verbatim (governance-vs-recall partition framing).
prompt_template.user: Same E27 user prompt structure; only the ORDER and TAG of the focal fact varies across cells. Prompt template will be locked in code BEFORE the first trial executes; SHA256 of prompt template recorded in results.

scoring.metric: cite-rate per cell (binary CITE/NO-CITE per trial, judged by same regex+keyword rule as E27)
scoring.secondary_metric: hedge-rate per cell (same E27 hedge detection)
scoring.judge_code_locked: Same e27 judge module, same SHA, version-pinned in results JSON.

falsifier_predicates.predicate: results JSON loads and all 120 trial records have required fields (trial_id, partition_tag, position, focal_fact_id, cite, hedge)
every one of the 6 cells has N>=18 OK trials
overall cite-rate across all 120 trials > 0.05 (model is willing to cite at all)
marginal partition-tag cite-rate (averaged across the 3 position levels) is computable for both decisions and observation cells
cite-rate at position=last > cite-rate at position=first by >=10pp (sanity check that the E27 position confound replicates)
falsifier_predicates.violation: INVESTIGATE — if position effect does not replicate, E27 itself was a fluke
NULL (partition tag does not drive citation independent of position)

verdict_logic.INVESTIGATE: F5 fails (position effect doesn't replicate — calls E27 itself into question)
verdict_logic.NULL: F1-F5 pass, F6 fails — partition-as-governance read-side claim is wrong, position dominates
verdict_logic.CONFIRM-GOVERNANCE: F1-F6 all pass AND direction is decisions > observation
verdict_logic.INVERTED-EFFECT: F1-F6 all pass AND direction is observation > decisions (E27 magnitude was real but the tag-meaning is inverted from claim)

statistical_analysis.primary: two-proportion z-test on marginal cite-rates (decisions vs observation, averaged across positions), alpha=0.10
statistical_analysis.secondary: 2x3 logistic regression with partition_tag and position as factors, interaction term included; report partition_tag main effect with 95% CI
statistical_analysis.covariate: native_partition of the focal fact (control for whether tag-swap interacts with the fact's home partition)

scope_grammar: Tests llama3:8b read-side response to partition tags in a single-shot prompt with 6-fact context. Says nothing about: (a) other models, (b) hook-enforced write-time governance, (c) multi-turn dialogue, (d) longer fact lists, (e) production retrieval flows.

downstream_implications.if NULL: partition-as-governance read-side claim must be retracted or restricted to position-controlled framings. Mechanism #3 (hook-enforced write-time governance) becomes the primary remaining defensible claim.
downstream_implications.if CONFIRM-GOVERNANCE: E27 verification's INVERTED-DIRECTION finding was a position artifact; the original gnosis-governance read-side claim is correct.
downstream_implications.if INVERTED-EFFECT: observation tag has higher cite-pull than decisions tag — the rail-encoding is upside-down and must be re-engineered.
